title: Median of two sorted lists
description: Two lists of integers are each sorted in ascending order (duplicates allowed, either list may be empty). Consider all elements of both lists together, as if merged into one sorted list of n elements. Return the median of that merged list: the element at position (n - 1) / 2 (counting from 0, whole-number division), which for an even n is the lower of the two middle elements. If both lists are empty there is no median, so return none.
notes: Lower median for even totals. All test inputs are sorted ascending. Not a sort task: a merge walk or counting walk is enough.
